text: A gentle and powerful companion for anyone with ADHD! Inflow has been a true game-changer for me during one of the most emotionally intense periods of my life. I live with ADHD, depression, and high sensitivity, and I often struggle with overwhelm, low motivation, and procrastination. The daily lessons, tips, and structure help me take small steps without guilt or pressure. It's supportive, well-designed, and truly made for people like me who need clarity, motivation, and compassion. Carole

developer_reply: Hi Carole! We are THRILLED to hear that you are feeling supported and gaining motivation, structure, and new tools with Inflow. If there is ever anything we can do for you, or if you have more feedback, just let us know at hello@getinflow.io! Have a wonderful day!

text: There's a before inflow and an after Inflow for me. This app has made my everyday life 200% easier and my mental health too as a consequence. Also, the inflow community is very supportive it's precious to not feel lonely anymore sometimes . I recommend to subscribe you won't regret it.
